description:
List this account's games in the klyo games catalogue: name, address (slug), state (published, or rejected with the reason), waiting version with its preview address, visits and plays. Read-only. Call this FIRST to learn the `slug` the other tools need. The list is light by default; `slug` returns one game with every field, `pelne: true` every game with every field.

Examples:
• Which games do I have on klyo?
• Is my game published yet?
• Show the state of my games

pelne.description: Every game with every field. Heavy: use only when you really need all of it.

slug.description: One game with every field (description, controls, tagline, translations…).

name: klyo_my_games
title: My games in the catalogue
